months.name: Avandra

holy_day.name: New Year's Day
holy_day.description: Feasts at dusk, discussing hopes for the new year until sunrise.

months.lore: The Change Bringer marks the end of Winter and the beginning of Spring, and with it ushers in a new year. Avandra's holy day falls on the first day of the first month, when the old year gives way to the new. People celebrate with feasts at dusk to watch the sunset and discuss their hopes for the new year, lasting until the sun rises.

months.name: Melora

holy_day.name: Wild's Grandeur
holy_day.description: Sailing and venturing into wild places to honor the Wildmother.

months.lore: Melora takes the Change Bringer's newfound warmth and cultivates it to bloom into full spring. Her holy day, Wild's Grandeur, is celebrated on the vernal equinox. People sail the open sea or venture into wild places to commune with the spirit of the wild lands herself.

months.name: Yondalla

holy_day.name: Luck's Favor
holy_day.description: Carousing, merry-making, and good deeds for halfling luck.

months.lore: Yondalla marks the end of spring, a time when spirits are high and folks are jovial. Her holy day is marked by carousing and merry-making as people reflect on the halfling way of life. Superstitious folk endeavor to do good deeds, hoping to be blessed with a little of the fabled halfling luck.

months.name: Corellon

holy_day.name: Elvendawn
holy_day.description: Elaborate music, fine wine, and dancing commemorating elves emerging from the Feywild.

months.lore: The holy day of Elvendawn, or High Summer, commemorates the elves first emerging from the Feywild. Folk celebrate with elaborate music, fine wine, and dancing.

months.name: Ioun

holy_day.name: The Knowing
holy_day.description: Meditation and reflection on learned knowledge.

months.lore: The Knowing Mistress keeps a more muted holiday, held in the middle of her month. Emphasis is on meditation and reflection — to consider all that one has learned throughout the year.

months.name: Pelor

holy_day.name: Highsun
holy_day.description: Feasting and large bonfires kept burning all night.

months.lore: The holy day of high summer is celebrated with feasting and great bonfires, kept burning through the night to symbolize the Dawnfather's light never extinguishing. It is a favorite of young children, who are allowed to stay up well past dusk in celebration.

months.name: Glittergold

holy_day.name: Fizzleboom
holy_day.description: Celebrating failures and lessons learned; explosive displays and pipe-smoke illusions.

months.lore: Fizzleboom comes just after High Summer and marks the coming of Autumn. Folk celebrate all of their failures and the joyous lessons learned from them. The parades are famous for displays of explosive power and elaborate pipe-smoke illusions.

months.name: Moradin

holy_day.name: Deep Solace
holy_day.description: Isolation and meditation on family; exchange gifts of craftsmanship.

months.lore: Moradin's holy day, Deep Solace, is celebrated on the eighteenth. Especially devout followers spend the day in isolation, meditating on the meaning of family and how they might be better mothers, fathers, siblings, or children. Emphasis is placed on creation, and worshippers often exchange gifts of craftsmanship.

months.name: Erathis

holy_day.name: Harvest Throne
holy_day.description: Elaborate harvest feasts; one empty seat left for the Lawbearer.

months.lore: The Lawbearer's holy day falls on the autumn equinox, the twenty-second day of his month. Folk celebrate with elaborate harvest feasts. One seat at every table is always left open for the Lawbearer himself, to bless those seated at his court.

months.name: Obitris

holy_day.name: Gatekeeper's Remembrance
holy_day.description: Day of remembrance, solemnity, and respect for the lost.

months.lore: The Gate Keeper's month honors the lost. The holy day of Remembrance is celebrated on the thirteenth day, just before the full moon. People honor their loved ones, believing that by remembering them, they do not truly die.

months.name: Sehanine

holy_day.name: Moonweaver's Masquerade
holy_day.description: Song, dance, drink, pranks, and masquerades; young lovers seek her blessing.

months.lore: The Moonweaver is celebrated on the night of the full moon. Elves spend the days leading up to it meditating upon their dreams, while everyone else celebrates with song, dance, and drink. Admired for her illusion and trickery, her holy day is paired with pranks, and she is often sought by young lovers hoping to win someone's heart. In large cities the day is marked with masquerades and elaborate parties.

months.name: Kord

holy_day.name: Day of Challenging
holy_day.description: Raucous festivals with jousting, wrestling, and martial combat.

months.lore: Kord's holy day, the Day of Challenging, falls on the seventh. One of the most raucous holidays, thousands attend elaborate festivals featuring physical sport — jousting, wrestling, and martial combat. Superstition holds that especially successful competitors can earn the favor of the Storm Lord himself.

months.name: Bahamut

holy_day.name: Embertide
holy_day.description: Remembrance and respect for those fallen in defense of others.

months.lore: The Platinum Dragon's month honors sacrifice. The holy day of Embertide is celebrated on the fifth day of the month. It is a day of remembrance, solemnity, and respect for those who have fallen in defense of others.

months.name: Raei

holy_day.name: Day of Forgiveness
holy_day.description: Forgiving slights and grudges; gift exchange before New Year's Day.

months.lore: The Day of Forgiveness ushers in a two-week period in which people forgive slights and grudges, hoping to enter the new year free of old hurts. Gifts are exchanged ahead of New Year's Day.

warp.description: The central, fixed moon. Remains in relatively the same position in the sky.
warp.behavior: Exerts predictable, daily tide cycles. Visible every night across all of Astoria.

weft.description: One of the twin ancillary moons.
weft.behavior: Traces a spiraling path around Warp over the monthly cycle. Varies in apparent size and visibility by region.

cross.description: One of the twin ancillary moons.
cross.behavior: Traces a spiraling path around Warp over the monthly cycle. Varies in apparent size and visibility by region.

king_tides.description: All three moons aligned. Exceptionally high and low tides, turbulent currents. Sailors remain dockside or in open sea. Coastal wetlands prone to flooding.

fool_tides.description: Weft and Cross at furthest from Warp, working against its pull. Weakest tidal fluctuations, calm currents, stable shoreline. Ship captains time dangerous passages for these days.
